title: Detective Conan 2-Hour Anime Special Opens in Theaters in Singapore, Philippines, Indonesia in November
content: Odex announced on Friday that its screening of Detective Conan: 30-gō Satsujin Jiken (The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30) , the franchise 's first new two-hour special in 10 years, will open in Singapore on November 14, and in the Philippines on November 7.
author: ANN

title: Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance Anime Film Opens in Taiwan on November 20
content: MediaLink International announced on Monday that it will open Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance (Heart's Resonance), the all-new feature-length anime film sequel to the Expelled from Paradise film, in Taiwan on November 20.
author: ANN

title: Sailor Moon S1 UK Steelbook Blu-ray Released on Monday
content: Based on the manga by Naoko Takeuchi , Sailor Moon was adapted as a 200-part TV series in Japan, running from 1992 to 1997. My Gift Lvl 9999 Unlimited Gacha was made by J.C. Staff in 2025 and is about a powerful Level 999 Overlord .

title: 'Sony YAY!' Airs New Episodes of Shin-chan TV Anime in India on November 2
content: The channel aired Eiga Crayon Shin-chan: Ora-tachi no Kyōryū Nikki ( Shin chan Our Dinosaur Diary ), the Crayon Shin-chan franchise 's 31st 2D animated film , in India in October 2025. The film premiered in Japan in August 2024. Eiga Crayon Shin-chan Chō Karei!

title: Bleach Surprises With First Episode Remake in Anime Finale – Watch Now
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has now come to an end with its final episode, and the anime went back 22 years with a special remake of one of the biggest moments from its very first episode.

title: Demon Slayer Studio’s Next Big Movie Hypes Crunchyroll U.S. Release – Watch New Trailer
content: Witch on the Holy Night is the next big movie coming from the same studio behind Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle , and Crunchyroll is gearing up for its release across the United States with a slick new trailer showing it off.

title: Welcome to Demon School Iruma-kun Confirms New Spinoff Release Date With First Look
content: Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun is coming back with a new spinoff anime next year, and the series has now confirmed its release date with the first real look at its alternate universe makeovers for fan favorite characters.
author: ComicBook

title: Detective Conan Anime's 4th Collection of Episodes 'Clash of the Red and Black' Streams on Crunchyroll, Netflix on November 1
content: Netflix had previously teased episodes for November 1. TMS began streaming the first specially curated selection of Detective Conan episodes in July 2025 on Netflix and Crunchyroll . The episodes are streaming in Japanese and with a new English dub by Studio Nano , different from the Bang Zoom! and Funimation dubs.
author: ANN

title: Tetsuya Chiba, Ashita no Joe’s Legendary Creator, Dies at 87
content: Tetsuya Chiba, the legendary creator behind manga hits such as Ashita no Joe and more, has died at the age of 87. Kodansha has announced that the legendary creator had passed away on October 22nd at the age of 87 due to myelodysplastic syndrome, disorders that impact bone marrow, at a hospital in Tokyo.
author: ComicBook
